reproduction.immutability: All observational modes refuse output overwrites; original input artifacts are always read from the helper checkout. No --update or source/expected mutation is performed. Use baseline and candidate source pins from execution_identities; helper postprocessing revisions are separately hashed.

limits: All original indexed assertions executed on one Windows x64 Node24.14.1 host; no cross-platform claim.
Actual candidate results and static proposed counts are separate. Raw proposal_executed:false fields remain counterfactual; actual candidate API/CLI/driver results provide execution evidence.
Per-source direct validation is not a claim that calc/render/reserve/signature consumers all perform ordinary validation; consuming-path results are independently captured.
Private parser-origin block evidence is identity-based; handbuilt/serialized models have only their retained model blocks. No lost physical source is reconstructed from raw text.

Native case journals link actual ordinary-validation and receipt/signature calls to assertions; other input/expected artifact paths remain in the exhaustive static catalog, not a fabricated per-read filesystem trace.

The93-file dynamic observer selects statically reachable validator imports; remaining test sources are cataloged as unexecuted here. Actual baseline2360/candidate2379 tests passed; no full-workspace-test claim.

Baseline unit consumer hooks were added later; unit receipt/signature call counts are not falsely paired. Complete native32-event consumer comparisons and separate same-bytes receipt probe supply actual paired evidence.

Initial harness failures and superseded observations are preserved and explicitly excluded. The earlier malformed Unicode spelling was superseded by exact U+4F5C U+8005 escapes; no broad run repeated for that correction.

Same-input receipt probe executes unsigned issue/verify and canonical signing preimages. It proves policy-count/signing-preimage change with identical subject/computation, not real cryptographic signatures, new receipt refusal or document-signature admission.

No RFC acceptance, normative activation, version selection, frozen source repair, fabricated principal, receipt/hash rewrite, new financial arithmetic or compatibility layer is authorized by this inventory.
